description:
Lily, the lady of the Aiden household and a baroness, has been secretly relieving her overflowing desires by drawing erotic illustrations for gossip novels ever since divorcing her unsatisfying ex-husband. However, even someone as passionate as Lily begins to find it increasingly difficult to create steamy drawings relying on imagination alone. Despite her secretary’s nagging, Lily still cannot produce the sensual scenes she used to—until she becomes captivated by the physique of Breck, the new assistant gardener who has just arrived…!
